_readme: Warm-ups and cool-downs, keyed by the muscle groups in muscleGroups.json.
general: always shown first in every session.
dynamic: added for each muscle group the session trains (warm-up, top of the workout).
cooldown: added for each muscle group the session trains (stretches, end of the workout).
Edit freely: each entry needs name, duration and desc. Duplicate names are shown once.

general.name: Light Cardio
general.desc: Bike, rower, jump rope or brisk walk. Get warm and slightly out of breath.

chest.name: Arm Swings & Chest Openers
chest.desc: Cross arms across chest, then pull back dynamically.

back.name: Band Pull-Aparts
back.desc: Light band, straight arms, squeeze shoulder blades together.

back.name: Lat Overhead Side Reaches
back.desc: Side bend with an overhead reach.

shoulders.name: Arm Circles (Forward & Reverse)
shoulders.desc: Small to large circles to warm the shoulder joint.

rear_delts.name: Band Face Pulls (Light)
rear_delts.desc: Pull to the face and rotate hands back.

biceps.name: Light Band Curls
biceps.desc: Easy tempo, full range of motion.

triceps.name: Light Band Pushdowns
triceps.desc: Easy tempo, lock out each rep.

forearms.name: Wrist Circles
forearms.desc: Interlace fingers and roll the wrists.

quads.name: Goblet Squat Hold w/ Pry
quads.desc: Sink deep into a squat and gently pry knees out.

glutes.name: Glute Bridges
glutes.desc: Squeeze glutes with a pause at the top.

calves.name: Ankle Rocks
calves.desc: Drive the knee over the toes to open the ankle.

core.name: Dead Bug (Slow)
core.desc: Keep the lower back pressed into the floor.

chest.name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
chest.desc: Lean forward in a doorway to stretch the chest.

back.name: Child's Pose w/ Lateral Reach
back.desc: Walk hands diagonally to stretch the lats.

shoulders.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
shoulders.desc: Pull the arm across the chest.

rear_delts.name: Thread the Needle
rear_delts.desc: On hands and knees, reach one arm under the body.

biceps.name: Wall Biceps Stretch
biceps.desc: Palm on the wall behind you, turn away gently.

triceps.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
triceps.desc: Reach behind the head and press the elbow down.

forearms.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
forearms.desc: Arm straight, gently pull the fingers back.

quads.name: Standing Quad Stretch
quads.desc: Hold the foot to the glute.

glutes.name: Pigeon Stretch
glutes.desc: Cross ankle over knee and lean forward.

calves.name: Wall Calf Stretch
calves.desc: Back leg straight, heel down, lean into the wall.

core.name: Cobra Stretch
core.desc: Press up gently and breathe into the stomach.
